quantities.description:

   Column porosity of the interstitial volume.
   Used only if model is not a Lumped Rate Model without Pores, in which case ``TOTAL_POROSITY`` is used instead.

quantities.description:
Total porosity of including the porosity of the particles.
Only applicable for the Lumped Rate Model without pores, i.e. when ``NPARTYPE = 1`` **AND** ``particle_type_000\HAS_FILM_DIFFUSION = 0``
quantities.span_text:
``TOTAL_POROSITY``

   Total porosity of including the porosity of the particles.
   Only applicable for the Lumped Rate Model without pores, i.e. when ``NPARTYPE = 1`` **AND** ``particle_type_000\HAS_FILM_DIFFUSION = 0``

quantities.description: Number of particle types. Defaults to 0.
quantities.span_text:
``NPARTYPE``

   Number of particle types. Defaults to 0.

quantities.description: Volume fractions of the particle types. The volume fractions can be set for all axial cells together or for each individual axial cell. For each cell, the volume fractions have to sum to :math:`1`. In case of a spatially inhomogeneous setting, the data is expected in cell-major ordering and the :math:`\texttt{SENS_SECTION}` field is used for indexing the axial cell when specifying parameter sensitivities.  This field is optional in case of only one particle type.
quantities.span_text:
``PAR_TYPE_VOLFRAC``

   Volume fractions of the particle types. The volume fractions can be set for all axial cells together or for each individual axial cell. For each cell, the volume fractions have to sum to :math:`1`. In case of a spatially inhomogeneous setting, the data is expected in cell-major ordering and the :math:`\texttt{SENS_SECTION}` field is used for indexing the axial cell when specifying parameter sensitivities.  This field is optional in case of only one particle type.

``COL_DISPERSION``

   Axial dispersion coefficient

   **Unit:** :math:`\mathrm{m}_{\mathrm{IV}}^{2}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}`

quantities.description:
Multiplexing mode of :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}`. Determines whether :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}` is treated as component- and/or section-independent.  This field is optional. When left out, multiplexing behavior is inferred from the length of :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}`.  Valid modes are: 

   0. Component-independent, section-independent; length of :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}` is :math:`1` 
   1. Component-dependent, section-independent; length of :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}` is :math:`\texttt{NCOMP}` 
   2. Component-independent, section-dependent; length of :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}` is :math:`\texttt{NSEC}` 
   3. Component-dependent, section-dependent; length of :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}` is :math:`\texttt{NCOMP} \cdot \texttt{NSEC}`; ordering is section-major
quantities.span_text:
``COL_DISPERSION_MULTIPLEX``

   Multiplexing mode of :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}`. Determines whether :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}` is treated as component- and/or section-independent.  This field is optional. When left out, multiplexing behavior is inferred from the length of :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}`.  Valid modes are: 

   0. Component-independent, section-independent; length of :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}` is :math:`1` 
   1. Component-dependent, section-independent; length of :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}` is :math:`\texttt{NCOMP}` 
   2. Component-independent, section-dependent; length of :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}` is :math:`\texttt{NSEC}` 
   3. Component-dependent, section-dependent; length of :math:`\texttt{COL_DISPERSION}` is :math:`\texttt{NCOMP} \cdot \texttt{NSEC}`; ordering is section-major

quantities.description: Initial concentrations for each component in the bulk mobile phase
quantities.span_text:
``INIT_C``

   Initial concentrations for each component in the bulk mobile phase

   **Unit:** :math:`\mathrm{mol}\,\mathrm{m}_{\mathrm{IV}}^{-3}`

quantities.description:
Full state vector for initialization (optional, ``INIT_C``, ``INIT_CP``, and ``INIT_CS`` will be ignored; if length is ``2NDOF``, then the second half is used for time derivatives).
The ordering of the state vector is defined in :ref:`UnitOperationStateOrdering`.
quantities.span_text:
``INIT_STATE``

   Full state vector for initialization (optional, :math:`\texttt{INIT_C}`, :math:`\texttt{INIT_CP}`, and :math:`\texttt{INIT_CS}` will be ignored; if length is :math:`2\texttt{NDOF}`, then the second half is used for time derivatives).
   The ordering of the state vector is defined in :ref:`UnitOperationStateOrdering`.

   **Unit:** :math:`various`

quantities.description: Number of liquid phase reaction models (optional, only if liquid reactions are present).
quantities.span_text:
``NREAC_LIQUID``

   Number of liquid phase reaction models (optional, only if liquid reactions are present).

quantities.description: Determines whether analytically computed Jacobian matrix (faster) is used (value is 1) instead of Jacobians generated by algorithmic differentiation (slower, value is 0)
quantities.span_text:
``USE_ANALYTIC_JACOBIAN``

   Determines whether analytically computed Jacobian matrix (faster) is used (value is 1) instead of Jacobians generated by algorithmic differentiation (slower, value is 0)

``SPATIAL_METHOD``

   Spatial discretization method

quantities.description: DG polynomial degree. Optional, defaults to 4 and :math:`N_d \in \{3, 4, 5\}` is recommended. The total number of axial discrete points is given by (``POLYDEG`` + 1 ) * ``NELEM``
quantities.span_text:
``POLYDEG``

   DG polynomial degree. Optional, defaults to 4 and :math:`N_d \in \{3, 4, 5\}` is recommended. The total number of axial discrete points is given by (``POLYDEG`` + 1 ) * ``NELEM`"

quantities.description: Number of axial column discretization DG elements. The total number of axial discrete points is given by (``POLYDEG`` + 1 ) * ``NELEM``
quantities.span_text:
``NELEM``

   Number of axial column discretization DG elements. The total number of axial discrete points is given by (``POLYDEG`` + 1 ) * ``NELEM``

quantities.description: Number of axial discrete points. Optional and ignored if ``NELEM`` is defined. Otherwise, used to calculate ``NELEM`` = :math:`\lfloor` ``NCOL`` / (``POLYDEG`` + 1 ) :math:`\rfloor`
quantities.span_text:
``NCOL``

   Number of axial discrete points. Optional and ignored if ``NELEM`` is defined. Otherwise, used to calculate ``NELEM`` = :math:`\lfloor` ``NCOL`` / (``POLYDEG`` + 1 ) :math:`\rfloor`

quantities.description: Specifies whether the collocation DG variant should be used. Optional, only existend for axial cylinder columns, defaults to 1.
quantities.span_text:
``USE_COLLOCATION_DG``

   Specifies whether the collocation DG variant should be used. Optional, only existend for axial cylinder columns, defaults to 1.

quantities.description: Specifies the linear solver variant used to factorize the semidiscretized system. Optional, defaults to ``SparseLU``. For more information on these solvers, we refer to the `Eigen documentation <https://eigen.tuxfamily.org/>`_
quantities.span_text:
``LINEAR_SOLVER``

   Specifies the linear solver variant used to factorize the semidiscretized system. Optional, defaults to ``SparseLU``. For more information on these solvers, we refer to the `Eigen documentation <https://eigen.tuxfamily.org/>`_

quantities.description: Number of axial column discretization points, i.e. FV cells
quantities.span_text:
``NCELLS``

   Number of axial column discretization points, i.e. FV cells

quantities.description: Type of reconstruction method for fluxes
quantities.span_text:
``RECONSTRUCTION``

   Type of reconstruction method for fluxes

quantities.description: Type of Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization, see IDAS guide Section 4.5.7.3, p. 41f. A value of :math:`0` enables classical Gram-Schmidt, a value of 1 uses modified Gram-Schmidt.
quantities.span_text:
``GS_TYPE``

   Type of Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization, see IDAS guide Section 4.5.7.3, p. 41f. A value of :math:`0` enables classical Gram-Schmidt, a value of 1 uses modified Gram-Schmidt.

quantities.description: Defines the size of the Krylov subspace in the iterative linear GMRES solver (0: :math:`\texttt{MAX_KRYLOV} = \texttt{NCOL} \cdot \texttt{NCOMP} \cdot \texttt{NPARTYPE}`)
quantities.span_text:
``MAX_KRYLOV``

   Defines the size of the Krylov subspace in the iterative linear GMRES solver (0: :math:`\texttt{MAX_KRYLOV} = \texttt{NCOL} \cdot \texttt{NCOMP} \cdot \texttt{NPARTYPE}`)

quantities.description: Maximum number of restarts in the GMRES algorithm. If lack of memory is not an issue, better use a larger Krylov space than restarts.
quantities.span_text:
``MAX_RESTARTS``

   Maximum number of restarts in the GMRES algorithm. If lack of memory is not an issue, better use a larger Krylov space than restarts.

quantities.description: Schur safety factor; Influences the tradeoff between linear iterations and nonlinear error control; see IDAS guide Section~2.1 and 5.
quantities.span_text:
``SCHUR_SAFETY``

   Schur safety factor; Influences the tradeoff between linear iterations and nonlinear error control; see IDAS guide Section~2.1 and 5.

quantities.description:
Optional, specifies whether an optimized Jacobian block structure is exploited by a custommized linear solver module for improved computational efficiency.
Prohibits mix of particle types and mix of FV, DG discretizations for bulk and particles.
quantities.span_text:
``FV_ARROW_HEAD_OPTIMIZATION``

   Optional, specifies whether an optimized Jacobian block structure is exploited by a custommized linear solver module for improved computational efficiency.
   Prohibits mix of particle types and mix of FV, DG discretizations for bulk and particles.

quantities.description: Determines whether the surface diffusion parameters :math:`\texttt{SURFACE_DIFFUSION}` are fixed if the parameters are zero. If the parameters are fixed to zero (:math:`\texttt{FIX_ZERO_SURFACE_DIFFUSION} = 1`, :math:`\texttt{SURFACE_DIFFUSION} = 0`), the parameters must not become non-zero during this or subsequent simulation runs. The internal data structures are optimized for a more efficient simulation.  This field is optional and defaults to :math:`0` (optimization disabled in favor of flexibility).
quantities.span_text:
``FIX_ZERO_SURFACE_DIFFUSION``

   Determines whether the surface diffusion parameters :math:`\texttt{SURFACE_DIFFUSION}` are fixed if the parameters are zero. If the parameters are fixed to zero (:math:`\texttt{FIX_ZERO_SURFACE_DIFFUSION} = 1`, :math:`\texttt{SURFACE_DIFFUSION} = 0`), the parameters must not become non-zero during this or subsequent simulation runs. The internal data structures are optimized for a more efficient simulation.  This field is optional and defaults to :math:`0` (optimization disabled in favor of flexibility).
